checks.lead: Eva Anna Paula Hitler (née Braun; 6 February 1912 – 30 April 1945) was a German photographer who was Adolf Hitler's longtime companion, and, briefly, his wife — they had been married for just under two days before they both committed suicide. Braun, then age 17, met Hitler, who was 40, in Munich in 1929. She was an assistant and model for Hitler's personal photographer, Heinrich Hoffmann. Braun began seeing Hitler often about two years later.
